_note: Line bank per day-type (the Ten God of the day stem against each Day Master). Cheeky, everyday, balanced: say what to do and the catch. Add new variants every week; never reuse a line within 30 days (see used_lines.json).
Friend: Someone agrees with everything you say today. Suspicious, but enjoy it.
Your people show up today. Make the group plan before someone else does.
You'll bump into someone exactly like you. One of you has to compromise.
Team effort day. Just don't turn the group chat into a competition.
Rival: Someone wants what you want. Share the credit, not the last piece of chicken.
Friendly competition today. Win it, then buy the kopi.
Watch the wallet: group dinners get expensive fast today.
Someone will eye your seat today. Stand your ground, politely.
Insight: Your shower thought is the good one. Write it down before you dry off.
Trust the weird hunch today. Just don't explain it to everyone yet.
Great day to learn something random. Bad day for small talk.
You want alone time today. Allowed. Reply to messages later.
Support: Ask for help today. Yes, you. Nothing bad will happen.
Someone older has the answer you need. Call them.
Rest counts as productive today. Nap without guilt.
Learning sticks today. Read the thing you saved three weeks ago.
Pressure: Today pushes back. Do the hardest thing first and the rest gets easy.
Someone tests your patience today. Count to five, then win calmly.
Deadline energy today. Good news: you work best under it.
Tough conversation day. Keep it short, kind and done.
Recognition: Someone notices your effort today. Act surprised.
Be on time today. Someone important is counting.
Good day for anything official: forms, meetings, asking for the raise.
Your reputation goes up today. Don't spend it all on one hot take.
Opportunity: Say yes to the random invite. Read the fine print first.
Money finds a side door today. Eyes open, wallet closed.
Good day to sell, pitch or hustle. Bad day to gamble.
Someone new could be useful today. Save their number, skip the impulse buy.
Steady-money: Not a shopping day. A checking-your-bank-app day.
Small, boring tasks pay off today. Do the admin.
Good day to pay back, pay off or plan ahead.
Practical beats exciting today. Pick the reliable option.
Joy: Cook something, share something. Calories don't count today. (They do.)
Make something just because. It's good for you.
Treat yourself, a little. Bubble tea counts as self-care today.
Your good mood is contagious today. Spread it in the group chat.
Speak-up: You're right today. Say it kindly and it actually lands.
Your opinions are spicy today. Maybe sleep on that email.
Ideas flow, rules feel annoying. Pick your battles.
Say the thing, nicely. Staying quiet costs more today.
